Heavy wooden #7A5232 and bronze #B8803A armor, living tree branches with green leaves #6CC36A sprouting from both shoulder pauldrons. Forest green #2E8B57 tabard with tree emblem, sturdy boots. Plain white background, single character, no text no watermark no logo no extra limbs no 3D rendering.
